info.name: Cluster Placement Groups Cluster Placement Groups CP API
Gets a list of all cluster placement groups.

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: A filter to return only the resources that match the specified compartment [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm).

params.name: lifecycleState
params.description: A filter to return only the resources that match the specified lifecycle state.

params.name: name
params.description: A filter to return only the resources that match the entire display name specified.

params.name: ad
params.description: A filter to return only the resources that match the specified availability domain.

params.name: id
params.description: A filter to return only the resources that match the specified unique cluster placement group identifier.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return.

params.name: page
params.description: A token representing the position at which to start retrieving results. This must come from the `opc-next-page` header field of a previous response.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either 'ASC' or 'DESC'.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort by. You can specify only one sort order. The default order for `timeCreated` is descending. The default order for `name` is ascending.

params.name: compartmentIdInSubtree
params.description: When set to `true`, cluster placement groups in all compartments under the specified compartment are returned. The default is set to `false`.

items.docs: Gets a list of all cluster placement groups in the specified compartment.

info.name: Move a cluster placement group to a different compartment.

params.name: clusterPlacementGroupId
params.description: A unique cluster placement group identifier.

items.docs:
Moves a cluster placement group resource from one compartment to another in the same tenancy. For information about
moving resources between compartments, see [Moving Resources to a Different Compartment](/iaas/Content/Identity/Tasks/managingcompartments.htm#moveRes).

When provided, If-Match is checked against ETag values of the resource.
